expect_red: whichever interface is chosen, the event the form writes stores one of AA.DIRECTIONS -- the names are what the form shows, never what it writes

mutations.contract: The interface names are what the form shows; the value it writes is always a stored direction word.
mutations.note: Makes the choices the NAMES rather than the stored words, so a chosen end can only be written as a name -- which buildBoundEvent's vocabulary check refuses.
mutations.replace: var choices = AA.DIRECTIONS.map(function (d) { return names[d] || d; });
